item.title: Privacy Policy
item.description:
This privacy policy explains how Jingyuan Zheng’s personal website handles visitor information, cookies, advertising, and third-party links.

Last updated: July 28, 2026.

Website Operator

This website is a personal website operated by Jingyuan Zheng and hosted on GitHub Pages.

Contact: mr.jingyuan.zheng@gmail.com

Information This Site Collects

The main site is static and does not provide payment forms or newsletters. Comments are powered by Waline. Comment data and interaction counters are stored in Neon PostgreSQL and accessed through the Waline service deployed on Vercel.

When posting a comment, a visitor may provide a nickname, comment, website, and email address. Email is optional and is used only for avatar matching and reply notifications; it is not displayed publicly in the comment area. The comment service may also process an IP address, browser, and operating-system information for rate limiting, abuse prevention, and moderation.

Comment text, nicknames, and submitted website links are public. Do not include passwords, home addresses, telephone numbers, or other sensitive information in a public comment.

If you contact me by email, I may receive the information you choose to send, such as your name, email address, and message content. I use that information only to read and respond to your message.

Hosting and Technical Logs

Site pages are hosted by GitHub Pages, the comment API is hosted by Vercel, and the comment database is hosted by Neon. These services may process standard technical information such as IP address, browser details, request time, and pages requested in order to provide hosting, database services, security, and abuse prevention. Their handling of this information is governed by their respective policies.

Cookies and Local Storage

The site theme may use local browser storage to remember display preferences such as light or dark mode.

This site may also use third-party services that set cookies or similar technologies. These services can include embedded content, external links, site verification tools, analytics, or advertising services.

Advertising and Google AdSense

This site may display Google AdSense ads.

Third-party vendors, including Google, use cookies to serve ads based on a user’s prior visits to this website or other websites. Google’s use of advertising cookies enables Google and its partners to serve ads based on visits to this site and other sites on the Internet.

Users may opt out of personalized advertising by visiting Google Ads Settings. Users may also visit www.aboutads.info to learn more about choices for personalized advertising from participating third-party vendors.

If other third-party ad networks are used in the future, this policy will be updated to identify them where appropriate.

European Users and Consent

For visitors in the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom, or Switzerland, this site may show a consent message before using advertising cookies or personalized advertising features where consent is required.

If Google AdSense is enabled, consent choices may be managed through Google’s Privacy & messaging tools or another Google-certified consent management platform.

Third-Party Links and Embedded Content

Articles may link to external websites such as GitHub, government websites, documentation pages, social platforms, or software project pages. External websites are controlled by their own operators and are not covered by this privacy policy.

Embedded or linked third-party content may collect data according to the third party’s own privacy policy.

Children’s Privacy

This site is intended for a general audience and is not directed at children. I do not knowingly collect personal information from children.

Changes to This Policy

I may update this policy when the site changes or when legal, hosting, analytics, or advertising requirements change. The latest version will be published on this page.

item.title: Backlink Rules
item.description:
This page explains the eligibility, submission methods, and maintenance principles for backlinks on this site. Please read the complete rules before applying.

Last updated: July 25, 2026.

Basic Requirements

  • The website should be an accessible personal site or independent blog with a clear name and original content that is still being maintained.
  • Backlinks are reciprocal. Add this site to your backlinks page before applying and make sure the link is publicly accessible.
  • It should use HTTPS and must not contain malicious redirects, scams, phishing, malware, or anything else that could put visitors at risk.
  • Sites centered on illegal material, explicit adult content, hate or harassment, piracy, advertising, copied content, or search-ranking manipulation will not be accepted.
  • Your subject, technology stack, traffic, and publishing schedule do not need to match this site. A genuine, complete, and maintained website is enough.

Information to Submit

Please include:

  1. Website name;
  2. Website URL;
  3. A one-line description;
  4. An avatar or site-icon URL;
  5. The URL of the backlinks page where you added this site;
  6. An English name and description, if available.

If no English name or description is supplied, the English backlinks page will preserve the original wording instead of inventing a translation.

How to Apply

Return to the Links page and submit your request through the embedded backlink application system.

Open the backlink application system

Comments remain open for discussion but are not an application channel. Add this site before applying and include the public backlinks page where the link can be verified. This site will add your link after confirming it. If you have trouble completing or submitting the form, email mr.jingyuan.zheng@gmail.com.

Review and Maintenance

  • Requests are reviewed manually. Meeting these rules does not guarantee acceptance, and there is no fixed response time.
  • After review, I will use the contact details supplied in the application to confirm whether it is accepted or declined. If declined, I will include the reason, so please watch for a response.
  • Names and descriptions normally use the applicant’s supplied wording. If the text is too long for the card, I may ask for a shorter version.
  • A link may be removed if the site remains unavailable, changes ownership, redirects elsewhere, or no longer meets these rules.
  • If the other site removes this site’s link without notice, its link may also be removed here.
  • Use the backlink application system to request an update when your URL, name, description, or avatar changes; email only if you run into a problem.

This Site’s Backlink Details

  • Name: Jingyuan
  • Website: https://jingyuan-zheng.github.io/
  • Description: Open-source projects, technology notes, and pieces of everyday life.
  • Avatar: https://jingyuan-zheng.github.io/img/avatar.png
  • RSS: https://jingyuan-zheng.github.io/index.xml

Thank you for maintaining your own corner of the web and for considering a link exchange.

Curriculum Vitae

Jingyuan Zheng

Industrial engineering and logistics management graduate with experience in operations research, supply-chain analysis, reliability modelling, inventory planning, simulation, and data-driven decision support. I use Python, statistical methods, and optimisation models to improve operational efficiency, resilience, and sustainability in complex logistics and engineering systems.

Academic Qualification

The University of Hong Kong

Sep 2024 - Sep 2025

Master of Science in Engineering · Industrial Engineering and Logistics Management

English-medium programme · Relevant coursework: Data-driven Optimization, Operational Research, Machine Learning and Applications, Physical Internet

Fuzhou University

Sep 2019 - Jun 2024

Bachelor of Management · Logistics Management

GPA: 3.69/4.0 (Rank: 2/35) · Relevant coursework: Python, Database Technology and Application, Operational Research, Forecasting Methods, Logistics System Optimization, Modelling and Simulation of Logistics Systems

Research & Technical Skills

Industrial Engineering & Operations ResearchMulti-objective optimisation, network-flow modelling, Monte Carlo simulation, sensitivity analysis, and decision support.
Logistics & Supply ChainInventory planning, reliability and resilience analysis, maritime supply-chain risk, material requirements planning, and logistics system optimisation.
Data Analysis & ResearchData cleaning, statistical analysis, questionnaire design, factor analysis, regression, machine learning, and reproducible analytical workflows.
ToolsPython, SQL Server, MATLAB, SPSS Statistics, Vensim, FlexSim, and Excel.

Research & Analytical Projects

Reliability Modelling and Decision Support for PV Microinverter Systems

Nov 2024 - Jul 2025

MSc Dissertation · The University of Hong Kong · Supervisor: Prof. Yao Cheng

  • Developed a reliability-driven decision-support model for PV microinverter spare parts, linking stochastic failure behaviour, replenishment lead time, downtime loss, lifecycle cost, and carbon-emission impact.
  • Applied CTMC-based reliability modelling, NSGA-II multi-objective optimisation, and Monte Carlo simulation to evaluate inventory policies under uncertain failures and supply conditions.
  • Conducted sensitivity analysis and translated model outputs into practical recommendations for inventory levels, lead-time control, reliability improvement, and system resilience.

System Dynamics Simulation of Operational Risk Evolution in Maritime Supply Chains

Oct 2023 - Jun 2024

Undergraduate Dissertation · Fuzhou University · Supervisor: Prof. Haidong Yang

  • Built a system dynamics model to simulate operational risk evolution in an international maritime supply-chain system using a three-tier risk indicator framework and questionnaire-based data.
  • Applied questionnaire reliability testing and factor analysis to process survey responses, determine indicator weights, and convert qualitative risk factors into model inputs.
  • Generated scenario-based recommendations for supplier reliability, logistics coordination, information-flow control, financial health, and operational resilience.

Machine Learning Classification of High-Dimensional Time-Series Signals

Dec 2024

Academic Project · The University of Hong Kong · Directed by Dr. Shujia Qin

  • Developed Python-based training and inference workflows for binary classification of 8,192-point time-series signals under limited domain information and a small labelled dataset.
  • Extracted and compared time-domain, frequency-domain, and power spectral density features to guide feature engineering and model design.
  • Implemented and compared a stacking ensemble, an RBF-kernel SVM, and a neural-network model with Bayesian hyperparameter tuning, documenting performance, limitations, and reproducibility.

Emergency Evacuation Optimisation Using Network Flow and Heuristic Algorithms

Nov 2024

Academic Project · The University of Hong Kong · Directed by Prof. Junwei Wang

  • Developed a network-flow-based evacuation optimisation model for disaster-management scenarios, balancing evacuation efficiency with fairness in shelter allocation.
  • Evaluated shelter utilisation, congestion, distribution balance, and resource-allocation performance using simulation-based results.
  • Proposed improvements for bottleneck reduction, fairer flow distribution, and more resilient emergency planning.

High-Quality Development Evaluation of Historical and Cultural Blocks in Fuzhou

May 2022 - May 2023

Undergraduate Research Project · Fuzhou University · Directed by Prof. Qin Zhang

  • Supported a questionnaire-based research project by applying factor analysis and AHP to construct and evaluate an indicator system for historical-community development.
  • Analysed development conditions and improvement priorities, translating quantitative findings into policy-oriented recommendations.

Analysis of Factors Influencing Students' Postgraduate Study Intentions

Mar 2022 - Jul 2022

Research Methods Project · Fuzhou University · Directed by Prof. Quan Cheng and Yong Hu

  • Designed and processed questionnaire data using SPSS, Likert-scale variables, and ordinal regression to analyse factors influencing postgraduate study intentions.
  • Converted survey responses into structured numerical variables and interpreted model results to support evidence-based recommendations for higher-education planning.

Internship Experience

Business Intern · Oriental Logistics Group (China) Ltd.

Feb 2024 - Apr 2024
  • Maintained shipment-status records by checking vessel-space allocation, ETD/ETA changes, booking updates, documentation issues, and cargo-information discrepancies against shipping-company and partner updates.
  • Maintained structured communication with customers, customs brokers, shipping companies, and partner firms, supporting schedule visibility and exception follow-up.

Material Planner · Xiamen Wu Zhen Ni Hai Import and Export Co., Ltd.

Jul 2023 - Sep 2023
  • Used Python, SQL, and inventory data analysis to review historical product flows, identify demand patterns, and support material-requirements planning.
  • Maintained structured inventory records and proposed stock adjustments that reduced excess stock for two seasonal products by approximately 25%.

Customer Information Administrator · Xiamen Haixi Real Estate Marketing Planning Co., Ltd.

Jul 2022 - Sep 2022
  • Applied data analysis and customer segmentation to build structured customer profiles and compile analytical reports supporting targeted sales follow-up.

Achievements

  • Nov 2025Tony Reynolds Academic Excellence Prize 2024-25, Department of Data and Systems Engineering, The University of Hong Kong
  • Jun 2024Outstanding Undergraduate Dissertation, Fuzhou University
  • Sep 2021Second-Class Prize, National College Students' Ecological and Environmental Protection Competition
  • Sep 2021Excellent Psychological Development Department Award, Fuzhou University; contributed as Director of the student psychological development team
  • Apr 2021 & Aug 2020Third-Class Scholarship, Fuzhou University

Additional Information

Languages: English (IELTS 6.5, Oct 2023; MSc completed entirely in English) and Mandarin Chinese (native).

Open-source work: I independently maintain this personal website and small open-source utility projects. View my work on GitHub.
